prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A young woman with long, wavy blonde hair sits casually atop a white cube against a seamless, soft white background. She wears a relaxed, contemporary outfit: a white graphic t-shirt, fitted white leggings with subtle black text or design elements, and clean white sneakers. Over her t-shirt, she has a loose, black jacket that adds a touch of contrast to the otherwise monochromatic palette. Her pose is playful and informal—one leg bent up on the cube, the other hanging off the edge, with one hand resting on her head as she laughs naturally, exuding warmth and spontaneity. The lighting is bright, diffuse, and even, eliminating harsh shadows and creating a fresh, airy atmosphere. The overall composition is minimalist and modern, with a shallow depth of field that keeps the focus entirely on the subject. The mood is lighthearted and approachable, reminiscent of a high-fashion editorial with a candid, youthful twist.
